correctness.rationale: Use the geometric blow-up lattice in the stated basis and pair its ten conic classes H−Ei and −K−(H−Ei). The vectors wi=2(H−Ei)+K in K⊥ have Gram matrix −4I; the 16 exceptionals have coordinates C=(−K−Σ si wi)/4, where si=C·wi and the five signs have product +1. This identifies the usual W(D5) with the even signed permutations on the 16 sign vectors; the action is faithful and fixes K. The fixed rank is 1 plus the number of positive signed coordinate cycles. Rational full rank also follows by averaging the 16 lattice generators onto the invariant subspace. The fixed integral kernel is saturated in P, so the product of the nonzero integer Smith factors of the orbit-sum columns in the integral blow-up basis is the required index, not just a rational rank. Independently enumerated all 1920 elements via even signed permutations, obtained all conjugacy classes by conjugating against this group, and used exact Smith forms. All 18 rows, including sizes, orders, ranks, orbit patterns and indices, agree as a multiset with the archived CSV independently of its representative words. Index histogram is 1:12, 2:3, 4:2, 16:1. For pattern 4^4 the (size,rank,index) rows are (20,1,1), (120,2,2), (60,2,4), (60,3,16). These establish the non-determination claim for types even at rank two. The real geometric effective cone is generated by the exceptional classes; averaging coefficients over Frobenius yields exactly the invariant cone generated by the orbit sums, without a claim about its integral semigroup.
residual_risks: The exhaustive lattice result does not assert Frobenius-type realizability over each fixed field or give a semigroup classification.
